question: E Krishna Iyer was related to which classical dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatnatyam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **E Krishna Iyer** was related to **Bharatnatyam,** which is a **classical dance** form originating from the southern state of India**, Tamil Nadu.**
 
• **Bharatnatyam** is known for its **grace, purity, and tenderness **of expression.
 
• It involves a lot of** facial expressions, hand gestures, and body movements** to convey emotions and tell a story.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi **is another classical dance form originating from the eastern state of India, **Odisha**.

 
 
• It is known for its** fluidity and gracefulness.**
 
 
 
• **Kathak** is a classical dance form originating from **northern India,** which involves a lot of **footwork and spins**.
 
• **Sattriya** is a classical dance form originating from the **northeastern state of India, Assam.**
 
• It is known for its simplicity and devotion to **Lord Krishna.**
